cards.india: For this fictional workshop, briefings in the first reporting cycle must remain confidential. A public aggregate report in the second cycle is allowed but optional. ASEAN must lead the consultations, with the United Nations providing support. The choice of an explicit confidentiality safeguard for individual case information is optional.
cards.uk-overlap: For this fictional workshop, the text must commit to publication of an aggregate humanitarian access report. This may occur in the first cycle or be guaranteed for the second cycle. Include an explicit confidentiality safeguard for individual case information. Either ASEAN-led or jointly chaired consultations are acceptable.
cards.uk-impasse: For this fictional workshop, the text must publish an aggregate humanitarian access report in the first reporting cycle itself. A promise to publish in the second cycle is insufficient. Include an explicit confidentiality safeguard for individual case information. Either ASEAN-led or jointly chaired consultations are acceptable.
